summary: The community.docker 3.10.1 fix for requests 2.32.0 only covers the vendored Docker SDK code. Modules using the Docker SDK for Python can still fail, for example with 'Not supported URL scheme http+docker'. Pin requests below 2.32.0 in that case.
questions: How do I fix 'Not supported URL scheme http+docker' errors?
Which requests version should I pin for Docker SDK modules?

answer_card.title: Fixing 'Not supported URL scheme http+docker'
answer_card.answer_md: community.docker 3.10.1 fixed requests 2.32.0 issues only for its vendored SDK code. Modules that use the Docker SDK for Python can still break. If you see `Not supported URL scheme http+docker`, pin `requests<2.32.0`.
